gameDescriptionHtml:
Welcome to the Kingdom of Arcana, a mesmerizing third-person action-RPG roguelite set in a sprawling medieval fantasy world brimming with magic and mystery. Immerse yourself in the epic tale of a once-thriving realm now enslaved by an ambitious and powerful mage, Aurelius, who, through cunning battles, has subjected the kings, lords, and soldiers of five distinct kingdoms to his will.

In the Kingdom of Arcana, you step into the shoes of Levi, a skilled mage, raised alongside Aurelius in a rivalry that forged both into formidable magical forces.

Fight for freedom
As the only hope against the sorcerer’s tyrannical rule, your journey unfolds across 50 captivating levels, each revealing a new facet of the enchanted lands. Embark on a quest to liberate each kingdom, facing not only the hypnotized soldiers but also powerful bosses – the lords and kings who fell victim to the sorcerer’s dark influence.

Five unique realms filled with beasts

50 levels are waiting for you in the game. In your journey, you will have to explore 30 iconic locations filled with soldiers of the realm you’re in and beat the lords and kings of every realm, for a total of 20 bosses.

Explore the intricacies of these realms, unearthing hidden traps and overcoming treacherous landscapes in your pursuit of freedom.

Master sorcery and combat
Master the art of combat as you unleash basic attacks like magic-infused punches and kicks, coupled with a dynamic spellcasting system. Begin your journey armed with three potent spells, and amass gold through triumphant victories to expand your magical repertoire with up to 20 more spells.

Discover chests scattered throughout the levels, containing vital potions such as healing elixirs, empowering tonics, mana-replenishing draughts, and protective armor brews.

The world’s last hope
The fate of the Kingdom of Arcana rests in your hands. Will you break the spell that enslaves the kingdoms and confront the malevolent sorcerer, or succumb to the darkness that engulfs this enchanted realm? The journey begins now, adventurer. The magic, the battles, and the destiny await you in the Kingdom of Arcana!

Game Features

  • Dive into the unique realms inhabited by the diverse races:
  • Orcs dwelling in lush forests
  • Trolls hidden within towering mountains
  • Golems roaming vibrant jungles
  • Dragons ruling over volcanic landscapes and rifts
  • Humans harnessing medieval city magic
